ran: Main-session model set in pairs: user vs project vs local vs --settings model keys (m1-m3), shell ANTHROPIC_MODEL vs --settings (m4), --model vs shell ANTHROPIC_MODEL (m5), --model vs a User env block (m11), user model key vs ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL (d1), shell ANTHROPIC_MODEL vs user model key (d2).
result: Each higher source won: project over user, local over project, --settings over local, ANTHROPIC_MODEL over --settings and over the user key, --model over ANTHROPIC_MODEL from the shell or an env block, and the user key over ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL.
method: dashboard/experiments/harness: claude -p in a throwaway HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and project under $TMPDIR, a fake key and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL on 127.0.0.1. fakeapi.py logs the model, output_config.effort and cache_control ttl of each request and answers 400; for agent cases it first streams one Agent tool call. The harness only allows requests to fakeapi.py on 127.0.0.1. Managed settings were not tested, because writing them needs admin rights.
